purpose: Use a genuinely different industry to falsify Longcycle's generic point-in-time industrial-memory primitives. This is an architecture verdict, not a benchmark-score claim and not an assertion that the ADC domain is exhaustively researched.

pressure_results.pressure: opposite clinical trajectories and temporal cognition
proved: Reality, Judgment/Expectation and Outcome can remain separate under no-lookahead replay.
Later outcomes do not rewrite what was knowable or expected at the earlier vintage.
Acquisition, impairment and termination events can remain separate accounting/trajectory scopes rather than one hindsight failure row.
Announced territory rights, global development lead, consolidated collaboration, current cooperation, trial lead sponsor and trial collaborator can remain distinct namespaced Reality predicates.
A later corporate acquisition does not force legal-party substitution or erase trial-role identity.
Valid event time and later-known recap time can remain distinct without lookahead.

pressure_results.pressure: indication, biomarker, readout and safety branching within one product
proved: 2019 HER2-positive approval scope, its accelerated pathway and contemporaneous ILD boxed-warning state can coexist with a separate 2022 HER2-low branch.
DESTINY-Breast04 topline outcome and HER2-low biomarker definition remain trial-scoped and do not collapse into a timeless product attribute.
A biomarker definition can use observed-at when the source proves presence by a vintage but not true onset.
A current registry sponsor snapshot can remain current-observation Reality without being backdated to the trial's earlier history.
ClinicalTrials.gov JSON can be archived as original bytes and grounded through deterministic canonical JSON artifacts plus exact JSON Pointer/value locators.
Exact-value mismatch fails closed; corrected expectations are recorded through an explicit repair artifact rather than relaxed equality.
Structured JSON need not be coerced into visible text to become Evidence.

architecture_verdict.decision: Do not add a new migration or pharma-specific schema from the selected ADC pressure set. The second industry materially stressed temporal cognition, role identity and within-product branching and the existing generic primitives remained truthful.

deferred_pressure.promotion_rule: Reopen only after an independent later trajectory reproduces the same semantic need under the pressure artifact's recorded gate. Do not choose a third industry merely to manufacture this recurrence.

next_product_step.rationale: The selected second-industry falsification set has done its architecture job. Additional ADC cases now have lower marginal architecture value than turning the proven manual/one-shot research path into a reusable, fail-closed orchestration path for real researchers and future industries.
next_product_step.first_target: Replace campaign-specific one-shot glue with one bounded reusable source-pack -> Grounded Evidence -> optional Reality execution contract that consumes repository specs, preserves exact hashes/authority/known-time gates, emits durable receipts, and respects GitHub Release versus Google Drive transport boundaries.
next_product_step.guardrail: Do not abstract away claim scope, epistemic layer, valid-time/known-time separation, source identity, or fail-closed exact grounding merely to reduce workflow boilerplate.
